title: When the Archive Sings
author: Wren Voss
blurb: Wendell Montrose, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the fleet's truce expires.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
